Apple WWDC 2020: iOS 14 summary slide

The keynote slide that summarizes iOS 14 as a grid of rounded dark tiles around a large gradient “iOS” tile.

Source
Apple Summary Slides (fan archive): Apple WWDC 2020
Creator
Apple Inc.
Made
2020-06-22 (WWDC 2020 keynote)
Style
Bento grid (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Organized, confident, playful
Evidence
Inspected the 1920 × 1080 WebP [WWDC 2020]-[iPhone]-[iOS 14].webp from the fan archive Apple Summary Slides (Ricky Zhang), which says that all images are screenshots of Apple event videos. The copy is a frame of the event video, not an Apple press file. Not stored.
Reviewed
2 October 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

Apple held WWDC 2020 online from 22 June 2020 and announced iOS 14 in the keynote. The fan archive files the slide under that event.

iOS 14 itself introduced home-screen widgets in small, medium, and large sizes; one tile of the slide shows them.

Observed

  • The ground is black. About fifteen tiles in dark grey fill the frame, with narrow even gutters and large rounded corners.
  • Tiles differ in size: a wide central tile, tall tiles at the right, and small squares at the left. The tiles line up on shared column and row edges.
  • The central tile is filled with an orange, pink, and violet gradient and carries a large white “iOS” in a bold sans-serif.
  • Each other tile shows one feature as an icon, an interface fragment, or a product illustration, with a short white label at the bottom: “Translate app”, “App Clips”, “Car keys”, “App Library”, “Widgets on the Home Screen”.
  • There are no outlines and no visible shadows. Tiles differ from the ground only by tone.

Why it belongs

This slide already has every trait of the core look, two years before design articles named it. The dark tile on a black ground is the night version of the light grey slides that followed.

Borrow

Put the product name in the center tile and let feature tiles of mixed sizes surround it.

Label each tile with one short line at the bottom, centered under its picture.
